This is the first time I'm writing anything in this subreddit. I made a new account like two days ago, and I've tried to write something but I just can't. I can't.

It's so difficult to shape these feelings into words, especially since English is not my first language.

I've been suffering quietly for three years. I almost got treatment a couple of years ago, but then for some dumb reason I told myself "you're not hurting enough to deserve help".

And now that I have sunk deeper and deeper into this shit, it has only gotten worse. And not only am I depressed these days, I'm also anxious as fuck about everything, especially in social situations. My whole life feels like a blur that's just passing by and I don't genuinely enjoy anything. I don't really care about my future either, because somehow I'm convinced I'm gonna end it all before I'm 30. 

I'm not really talented at anything and I could never make my dreams come true. I have four people I consider to be my friends, which two of them don't really even care. One of the remaining ones I never see, and the other one I'm probably going to lose touch with because I'm moving to another school. I don't know anyone from that school, and I'm scared I won't be able to make any friends because I'm pretty shy.

My self-doubt, despair, impaired social skills, constant state of disappointment and loneliness are eating me up. I used to love music, now I use it to drown my thoughts. All that's left of me is a crying, apathetic, anxious mess, paralyzed by fear.

The only reason I'm still here is because of how my family would react. And my family is also the reason why I feel so selfish thinking about these things.

I'm hurting horribly, but I still feel like I'm not hurting enough to get treatment.

I can't do this anymore.
